candidate_attempt_rule: Five candidate slots are shared across all K targets. Each may use at most one new real tactical CLI and one fixed full-stage simulation. Contract or static failures retain the slot; only STARTED processes and simulations count against their applicable limits.
capacity_stop_rule: If a started real CLI fails with an explicit service-capacity message and produces no tactical output, archive the failure, stop starting further M74 CLI calls this round, and preserve unused M74 budget as blocked by service capacity.
counting_rule: Count each real tactical CLI process and each fixed full-stage simulation at STARTED, including failures and timeouts. A WIN freezes that candidate, updates best N, and sets the next K=N-1; continue only while total M74 slots remain. No automatic retry, resume, replacement call, historical balance transfer, or sixth candidate.
non_stackable: M73 ended at candidate attempts 5/5, CLI 5/5, and simulation 5/5; its unused balances do not transfer. M70 V1 remains the frozen 8-ID WIN until a smaller-ID M74 WIN is verified.
